cc:Work.dc:title: ColBERT perturbation controls
cc:Work.dc:description: Corrected ColBERT function-to-content absolute token-contribution change ratios. Identity name, n=280, ratio 1.39; Numeral*, n=280, ratio 1.61; Nonsense word, n=280, ratio 1.59. Blue intervals resample tests; orange intervals resample swap pairs. All intervals are 95 percent bootstrap confidence intervals. Numeral star uses modified templates. There are five swap pairs per condition. Comparisons do not establish equivalence.
